prompt: Create a refined full-body anime-style illustration of a graceful androgynous young man standing on a sunlit wooden veranda by the sea in early autumn. He is tall and slim with very pale skin, delicate elegant facial features, narrow calm eyes, and long platinum blond hair tied into a low side ponytail with soft loose strands around the face. He looks slightly to the right with a faint composed smile, giving a serene aristocratic mood. Dress him in traditional Japanese autumn formalwear: a muted lavender-gray kimono, a wide black obi, white tabi socks and black geta sandals, with a deep eggplant-purple haori draped over the shoulders. The haori should billow gently and reveal an ornate inner lining on one side with gold lattice patterns, cloud motifs, and white chrysanthemum flowers. Add a white beaded haori cord with a small dark green jewel at the chest. He holds a closed dark folding fan in one relaxed hand, while the other hand rests lightly on the wooden railing; a short sheathed accessory or fan case is tucked at the waist. Set the scene on a pale weathered wooden deck with vertical posts and horizontal railings, bright sparkling ocean water behind him, faint distant islands on the horizon, and soft red maple leaves drifting in the foreground and upper left. Use a delicate Japanese otome-game / joseimuke illustration style with thin clean linework, translucent pastel colors, soft watercolor-like shading, luminous backlight, airy atmosphere, subtle fabric folds, and elegant clothing detail. Composition is vertical portrait, full body centered, slightly low viewpoint, lots of white light and sea sparkle, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的全身动漫风格插画，描绘 一位优雅的中性风青年 站在初秋阳光明媚的海边木质走廊上。他身材高挑纤细，皮肤白皙，五官精致优雅，眼神狭长平静，留着一头 白金色 长发，扎成低侧马尾，脸颊两侧散落着柔和的发丝。他微微向右侧身，带着淡淡的从容微笑，散发出宁静的贵族气质。为他穿上传统的日本秋季正装：一件柔和的薰衣草灰和服，搭配宽大的黑色腰带、白色足袋和黑色木屐，肩上披着一件深茄紫色的羽织。羽织应轻轻飘动，露出一侧带有金色格纹、云朵图案和白色菊花的华丽内衬。胸前饰有一条白色珠串羽织绳，中间镶嵌着一颗深绿色宝石。他的一只手放松地握着一把闭合的深色折扇，另一只手轻搭在木质栏杆上；腰间别着一个短小的鞘状配饰或扇套。场景设定在褪色的浅色木质甲板上，背景是波光粼粼的大海和地平线上隐约可见的远岛，前景和左上方飘落着柔和的红枫叶。采用精致的日本乙女游戏 / 女性向插画风格，线条纤细干净，色彩呈半透明的粉彩色调，带有柔和的水彩感阴影、明亮的逆光、空气感氛围，以及细腻的衣物褶皱和优雅的服饰细节。构图为竖向肖像，全身居中，视角略低，充满白色的光影与海面波光，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。
